subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.**

Indispensable
solution:
The correct answer is: **Essential**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Indispensable **means absolutely necessary or essential; incapable of being disregarded or neglected. (अपरिहार्य)

 
 
• **Example**: *Water is indispensable for life; without it, survival is impossible.*
